title: Young teen in wreck has brief memory of bright white light and wheat field
content:
I am not even sure it was an NDE, but it was a strange experience.

I was in a wreck as a young teenager. I was knocked out, but I had the sensation of tumbling through a wheat field that I could clearly visualize, with a bright white light pushing me from behind. It was a peaceful experience; no fear.

I didn't know what was going on. For a while I couldn't talk, when it was over. Then I was able to call out for help, since I was under the back seat. I walked away without a scratch.

It was a serious accident. Everyone involved had serious injuries and one person was even killed.

I used to think it was just a strange experience, but when people started talking about NDEs, I wondered if it was possible that’s what happened to me. All of the ER doctors were amazed that I had no visible injuries.
